calls.statement:
SELECT
  s.store_name,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE s.store_id NOT IN (900, 999)  -- Exclude web shop and training store
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'  -- Exclude test articles
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13  -- Period 3
  AND s.store_name = 'Lahti'
  AND p.product_name ILIKE '%Interior Paint%'
GROUP BY s.store_name, p.product_name
